entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: How long will you speak these things, since the words of your mouth [are like] a strong wind?

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Does God pervert judgment? Or does the Almighty pervert justice?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If your sons have sinned against Him, and if He has cast them away for their transgression,

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: if you would seek earnestly to God and make your prayer to the Almighty;

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: if you [were] pure and upright, surely now He would awake for you, and make the dwelling-place of your righteousness blessed.

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: And if your beginning was small, yet your end would greatly increase.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: For please ask of the former age, and prepare yourself to the search of their fathers,

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: for we [are but of] yesterday and know nothing, because our days on earth [are] a shadow.

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Shall they not teach you, [and] tell you, and speak words out of their heart?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the reed-grass grow without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: While it [is] yet in its greenness, and not cut down, it dries out before any [other] herb.

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So are the paths of all who forget God; and the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: His hope shall be cut off, and his trust [shall be] in a spider's web.

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He shall lean on his house, but it shall not stand; he shall hold fast to it, but it shall not endure.

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He [is] moist before the sun, and his branches shoot forth in his garden.

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots are wrapped around the heap, [and] he sees the place of stones.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he is destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him: I have not seen you.

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: Behold, this [is] the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: Behold, God will not cast away the innocent, nor will He help the evildoers,

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: until He fills your mouth with laughter, and your lips with rejoicing.

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: Those who hate you shall be clothed with shame; and the tent of the wicked [shall be] no more.
